question: Should CodexBar permanently add this cross-provider local Share Stats surface to the status menu and Settings?
rationale: VISION.md explicitly requires sign-off for new product features and meaningful maintenance complexity, and the available discussion does not establish maintainer approval for this permanent surface.

options.title: Approve narrow local export
options.body: Keep the privacy-first export, consolidate its aggregation seam with the companion dashboard, and require current-head real-bundle proof before merge.

options.title: Decline the product surface
options.body: Do not add permanent menu or Settings entry points, leaving existing CLI text and JSON output as the supported data-export path.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow local export
recommendation.body: Keep the privacy-first export, consolidate its aggregation seam with the companion dashboard, and require current-head real-bundle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner defines the applicable product sign-off boundary and is best positioned to decide whether this permanent UI belongs in CodexBar.
